target_abstracts.time capsule: The time capsule is a machine that carries a person across time. It is long and curved, shaped in standing capsule form. Its surface looks like solid steel—smooth, seamless, and highly reflective, so anyone standing near it can see themselves as in a mirror. with no carvings, joints, or signs of tools. It seems heavy as stone but shines with the finish of advanced craft. To Daniel, it is clearly not a natural rock or ruin but a constructed vessel from his own age.
